historical_growth.growth_rate_source: equity_3yr_cagr (5-year figures are inflated by the 2020-21 equity placings and the COVID-era revenue surge)
historical_growth.growth_divergence_warning: Equity 3yr CAGR 10.5% vs EPS 3yr CAGR 4.7% (>30% divergence): book grew on retained earnings and FV/FX gains while 2023-24 EPS fell with the biotech-funding downturn. Revenue 3yr 12.6% is the better anchor; FY2026 guidance is 15-18% in RMB.
historical_growth.notes: Owner-FCF (reported FCF - SBC; interest income is already outside OCF) was negative FY2018-FY2024 (-707, -2,206, -4,420, -3,608, -1,561, -652, +72 in FY2024) and +1,701 in FY2025, so 3y/5y FCF CAGRs are undefined (negative start). SBC fell from 8.1% to 4.4% of revenue FY2022-FY2025, so SBC is shrinking relative to cash flow rather than growing faster.

scenario_narratives.base: Raised FY2026 guidance is delivered (16.5% RMB growth) and the 78 late-phase / 28 commercial projects convert to manufacturing revenue at a pace somewhat below management's ~30% manufacturing CAGR, so group growth runs 15% then 13% before fading to mid-single digits. WuXi XDC keeps compounding but its gains are shared 49/51 with minorities (captured by deducting the XDC minority at market). BIOSECURE designation risk lingers but does not force US private-sector clients to leave; Western de-risking slows new-logo wins at the margin. Operating EBITDA margin matures at ~47% as the Singapore/US/Ireland plants fill and capex falls from ~21% to ~10.5% of revenue.
scenario_narratives.bull: BIOSECURE resolves benignly (WuXi Biologics left off the OMB list due 18 Dec 2026, or the 1260H route is enjoined as for WuXi AppTec), the funding recovery in biotech persists and management's ~20% cc 3-year group CAGR is met in RMB. Commercial-manufacturing conversions (34 PPQs in 2026, 100% success rate) and new modalities (bispecifics, ADC via XDC/BioDlink, peptides) lift margin to ~49.5%, and the global dual-sourcing footprint wins share from clients that need non-China capacity from a China-cost operator.
scenario_narratives.bear: WuXi Biologics is designated as a biotechnology company of concern; FY2026 is locked in by backlog (14%) but new US/EU business wins collapse as clients friend-shore to Samsung Biologics, Lonza and Fujifilm, and growth falls to 4-6% for several years. The fixed-cost GMP network built for the base case runs under-utilised, so margin slides to ~40.5% while D&A rises toward 9.5% of revenue; capex is cut once committed projects finish. XDC, consolidated but only half owned, is the main remaining growth engine.

valuation_philosophy.summary: Owner-FCF DCF on consolidated RMB flows with SBC fully expensed and interest income stripped; non-operating investments and net cash added, and the WuXi XDC minority deducted at its market value. The valuation is a judgment on whether the post-2025 recovery in growth and margin persists through the BIOSECURE overhang; geopolitical risk is carried in the 25% bear weight, not the discount rate.
key_risks_to_valuation: BIOSECURE / 1260H designation of WuXi Biologics (OMB list due 18 Dec 2026)
Western client de-risking away from China-domiciled CDMOs and Samsung Biologics capacity additions
Utilisation risk on the ~20%-of-revenue capex programme if biotech funding softens
XDC minority deduction moves with 2268.HK's price (~RMB0.4bn per HK$1 on XDC; HK$0.1 per WBio share)
RMB appreciation against USD/EUR compresses reported revenue (H1 FY2026: 18.4% RMB vs 23.4% USD growth)
Discount rate: an RMB-built 9.5% on predominantly USD revenue; a USD-built rate would be ~1.5pp higher

inputs.share_count_basis: Fully diluted: H1 FY2026 weighted diluted count 4,180,889,317 (basic 4,096.6m + options 28.2m + restricted shares 56.0m; interim note 12). Shares in issue at 30 Jun 2026 were 4,143.4m. Held FLAT because SBC is fully expensed in the flows; buybacks (RMB1,576.6m FY2025, RMB1,020.9m H1 FY2026, US$400m programme) are what funds the flat count.
inputs.sbc_source: FY2025 annual report cash-flow statement share-based compensation add-back RMB955.1m (H1 FY2026 RMB454.7m). Equity-award taxes: none disclosed (HK/Cayman scheme settles through trustee-held shares; EquityAwardTaxes = 0 every period).
inputs.fx_note: 1 CNY = 1.1724 HKD, Yahoo CNYHKD=X at 2026-10-16T22:01Z. Cross-check: Yahoo HKDCNY=X 0.8505 (2026-10-17) inverts to 1.1758, a 0.3% tie, confirming direction (HKD per CNY > 1). No dual listing of 2269 to parity-check against. All flows modelled in RMB millions and per-share values converted to HKD at this rate. refresh_price.py does not move fx_rate; refresh it by hand on later price-only updates.
inputs.wacc_rationale: Flows in RMB. All-equity discount rate since the group is net cash: China 10y CGB ~1.9% + beta ~1.15 x China ERP ~6.75% = ~9.6%, rounded to 9.5%. Revenue is ~58% North America / USD-denominated, so a USD-built rate (US 10y ~4.2% + similar ERP) would be ~1.5pp higher; the RMB rate is used because the statements and every projected flow are RMB. The BIOSECURE/1260H geopolitical risk is charged in the flows and the 25% bear weight, NOT as a WACC premium, and WACC is identical across scenarios (charge risk once).
inputs.lease_treatment: Treatment (A), leases as debt: IFRS-16 lease liabilities RMB2,049.9m (30 Jun 2026; mostly long-dated leasehold land and facilities) are included once in total_debt alongside bank borrowings RMB675.8m; lease principal (~RMB150m/yr) is NOT deducted from flows and lease_cost_pct_path is zero.
inputs.nci_treatment: Flows are CONSOLIDATED (100% of WuXi XDC, BioDlink, Bestchrom). NCI is charged once, in the equity bridge: the 49.37% minority in WuXi XDC (2268.HK) at market value (1,261.6m XDC shares x HK$74.45 at 2026-10-16 / 1.1724 = RMB80.1bn market cap x 49.37% = RMB39,551m), plus other NCI (BioDlink 39.3%, Bestchrom minorities, small subsidiary schemes) at estimated book ~RMB800m. Market value is used for XDC rather than book (RMB5.3bn) because XDC trades at ~54x trailing earnings and is the fastest-growing part of the consolidated flows; book would overstate WBio's equity by ~RMB34bn. This is conservative versus a model-consistent NCI share (~15-16% of consolidated profit).
inputs.notes: MODEL: owner-FCF component DCF, 10-year horizon, scenario-weighted. Routed per dcf-methods SKILL.md as a non-US operating company (biologics CRDMO) with currency, lease and NCI adaptations; not a bank/REIT/holdco. First valuation of this ticker (no MEMORY.md entry). EBITDA basis: 'adj_ebitda' here is OPERATING EBITDA before SBC, excluding interest income, FX and fair-value gains: FY2025 gross profit 10,018.5 - ECL impairment 205.3 - S&M 608.8 - admin 1,704.5 - R&D 853.4 + grants ~245.1 (other income 639.7 less interest income 394.6) = EBIT 6,891.6; + D&A 1,642.9 (company EBITDA 9,042.9 less PBT 7,256.9 less finance costs 143.1) + SBC 955.1 = 9,489.6 = 43.6% margin (company 'adjusted EBITDA' 45.1% also strips FX/FV items). H1 FY2026 on the same basis 43.8% vs 41.7% H1 FY2025 (H2 is seasonally stronger). Cash tax: RMB1,400.1m paid FY2025 / EBIT 6,891.6 = 20.3%. Owner FCF FY2025 = reported FCF 2,655.8 (OCF 6,340.9 - PP&E capex 3,685.1) - SBC 955.1 = 1,700.7 (7.8% margin), depressed by a RMB2.67bn receivables build (WC drag 1,729 on a 3,115 revenue increase); TTM to Jun 2026 owner FCF ~3,339 (14.1% of TTM revenue 23,624); capex is still above D&A (16.9% vs 7.5%) because of the Singapore/US/Ireland/China build-out, which is why the horizon is 10 years. Interest income is not in reported FCF (see interest_income_note), so no further strip is needed; net cash RMB10.3bn is added in the bridge. Cash includes bank balances 8,904.4 + time deposits 3,520.8 + wealth-management products 603.0 (30 Jun 2026). Non-operating assets in the bridge (their FV gains are excluded from EBITDA): Duoning associate at FVTPL 1,210.8, listed/unlisted equity at FVTPL 1,819.9, Bestchrom disposal group held for sale (net 1,338.8; sale agreed Jul 2026, closing Dec 2026; its small operating earnings remain in the flows, an immaterial overlap). The full FY2026 flow is projected although H1 FY2026 cash (owner FCF ~RMB0.87bn) is already in the 30 Jun 2026 balance sheet: an immaterial ~HK$0.24/share overlap, noted not adjusted. Buybacks: active repurchaser (RMB1.0bn H1 FY2026), so the flat count is funded, not a convention.
inputs.interest_income_note: Interest income (FY2025 RMB394.6m, H1 FY2026 RMB205.7m) is adjusted OUT of operating cash flow in the cash-flow statement ('Interest income from banks and other financial assets at amortized cost (394,582)') and received in investing, so reported FCF (OCF - capex) already excludes it. Deducting it again would charge it twice; interest_income is therefore 0 in the owner-FCF bridge. The component build also excludes it from EBITDA, so the RMB13.0bn cash pile is counted only in the bridge.

base.growth_rationale: FY2026 at the midpoint of raised RMB guidance (15-18%; H1 +18.4%). FY2027-28 at 15%/13%, below management's ~20% cc 3-year group target because RMB reporting and a still-unresolved BIOSECURE overhang argue for a haircut; then a glide to 6% by year 10.
base.margin_rationale: Operating EBITDA pre-SBC 43.6% FY2025, H1 FY2026 43.8% (+210bp YoY) on utilisation and manufacturing mix; matures at 47%, roughly Samsung Biologics/Lonza-class, not above it.
base.capex_rationale: H1 FY2026 capex 23.4% of revenue (Singapore DP, MFG11/MFG18 US, China); glides to 10.5% vs 9% D&A by year 10 as the build-out completes.
base.wc_rationale: Net operating working capital (receivables 8,347 + contract costs 2,285 + inventories 1,758 + contract assets 182 - payables 3,232 - contract liabilities 3,499) = ~5,840, ~25% of TTM revenue; capture -25% of each revenue increase. FY2024-25 actual drag was ~50% of the increase (receivables build), H1 FY2026 reversed part of it.

required_return_table.note: Each row rebuilds the terminal value at that row's rate (max(0, min(Gordon@r, 18x FCF_N))); the WACC row is valuation.base.intrinsic_value and the hurdle row is entry_price.base.entry_price.

sensitivity.note: Rows are WACC, columns terminal growth; each cell rebuilds its own terminal value.

probability_weighted.weights_rationale: Bear raised to 25% from the 15% default because of a single-regulator binary: OMB's initial BIOSECURE list is due 18 Dec 2026 and sister company WuXi AppTec is already on the 1260H list (enjoined, not removed), with ~58% of revenue from North America. Base 50% reflects guidance being raised and tracking ahead. Bull cut to 25% because it needs both a benign geopolitical outcome and management's ~20% CAGR in RMB.

sanity_check.basis: SBC-adjusted on both sides (EPS less SBC/share; EBITDA less SBC), so these deliberately do not match GAAP screener multiples.
